title: Filtration of a constructible sheaf by extensions by zero of lisse sheaves
statement:
Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, $\Lambda=E$ or $\Qlb$, and $F\in\Cons(X,\Lambda)$. Let
$S_1,\dots,S_m$ be a stratification adapted to $F$, ordered as in
[det-lem-coefficient-heart-common-stratification] (1), so that $V_k=S_1\cup\dots\cup S_k$ is
open, with open immersions $v_k\colon V_k\hookrightarrow X$, and let $a_k\colon S_k\hookrightarrow X$.
Put $F_k=v_{k!}v_k^*F\subseteq F$. Then
$$
0=F_0\subseteq F_1\subseteq\dots\subseteq F_m=F,\qquad F_k/F_{k-1}\cong a_{k!}(F|_{S_k}),
$$
and each $F|_{S_k}$ is lisse.
Here $V_0=\varnothing$, and lisse means locally free of finite rank for the pro-étale topology. The category $\Cons(X,\Lambda)$ is the category of constructible $\Lambda_X$-modules of [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. For a locally closed immersion $a\colon S\hookrightarrow X$, write $a=i\circ u$, where $u\colon S\hookrightarrow\overline S$ is open and $i\colon\overline S\hookrightarrow X$ is closed, and define $a_!=i_*u_!$. The inclusions in the filtration need not be strict.

proof.text: Identify pulled-back coefficient rings with the prescribed $\Lambda_T$ using [sk-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients] (1). By [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-open-subscheme-noetherian] every open in $X$ is Noetherian and quasi-compact, and by [lem-weil-pbc-locally-noetherian-quasi-separated] it is quasi-separated. Each inclusion between these opens is quasi-compact, since its inverse image over an affine is such an open; it is quasi-separated since its diagonal is an isomorphism. Thus localization and the nested-open theorem below apply.

source.place: First paragraph: coefficient identifications and geometric hypotheses.

proof.text: Localization [det-sf-open-closed-sequence-ring-sheaf] (3) makes every counit $F_k\to F$ mono. Apply [lem-sfb-open-filtration-successor] to $W=V_{k-1}\subseteq V_k=V$: its map $d_F:F_{k-1}\to F_k$ composes with the $V_k$ counit to the $V_{k-1}$ counit. Hence $d_F$ is mono and represents $F_{k-1}\subseteq F_k$ over $F$. The left adjoint from the zero module category on $\varnothing$ is zero, while the identity-open adjunction is the identity. Thus $F_0=0$ and $F_m=F$.

source.place: First paragraph: counit subobjects, nesting and endpoints.

proof.text:
For each $k\geq1$, the stratum immersion $c:S_k\hookrightarrow V_k$ is closed with image $V_k\setminus V_{k-1}$. The cokernel assertion of [lem-sfb-open-filtration-successor], evaluated at $F$, gives
$$F_k/F_{k-1}\cong v_{k!}c_*c^*v_k^*F=v_{k!}c_*(F|_{S_k}).$$
The quotient is the cokernel of the actual inclusion from step 2, because the theorem specifies its composite counit.

source.place: Second paragraph: exact open extension of localization, with the specified nesting map.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-locally-closed-extension-coherence] with $R=\Lambda_X$ and $a_k=v_kc=iu$, where $i,u$ are the closure factorization in the statement. Its normalized comparison gives $v_{k!}c_*\cong i_*u_!=a_{k!}$. Substitution in step 3 gives the claimed quotient. Step 1 identifies its inverse-image rings with the coefficient rings used here.

source.place: Second paragraph: independence of the two locally closed factorizations.

proof.text: By adaptedness and the final characterization of [det-lem-coefficient-heart-closure], each $F|_{S_k}$ is lisse. The filtration inclusions are non-strict; for example all are equal when $F=0$.

source.place: Final sentence: lisseness on the given adapted strata.
